changelog.title: Dolby Atmos Audio & Glowing Badge
changelog.description: Full-screen player features an authentic Dolby Atmos Double-D badge with an ambient animated glow, with adaptive hardware and addon audio detection.

changelog.title: 120 FPS Canvas-to-Lyrics Fluidity
changelog.description: Transition animation from full-screen Spotify Canvas to lyrics runs at locked 60/120 FPS using zero-recomposition Draw-phase execution and continuous Skia GPU blur.

changelog.title: Zero-Glitch Interactive Player Drag
changelog.description: Smooth vertical drag gesture between miniplayer and full player with zero layout glitches, persistent miniplayer album art, and instant album navigation.

changelog.title: Resilient Artwork Pipeline
changelog.description: Multi-tier artwork fallback architecture ensuring album, artist, and folder hero backgrounds and thumbnails remain crisp without disappearing.

additionalNotes: To get the best from Obsidian, please keep your device up to date and regularly check for software updates.
